# jumpcloud_command (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud command.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_command" "example" {
  name = "Security Posture Check"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the command.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) The script content.
- `command_type` (String) The platform type.
- `name` (String) The name of the command.
- `shell` (String) Shell used for execution.
- `sudo` (Boolean) Whether elevated privileges are used.
- `trigger` (String) Trigger type.
- `user` (String) Execution user context.
